purpose: Authority manifest for INSA-ID-E1. Records the executor's authority scope, grant provenance, freshness evidence, capability/permission separation, traceability, and no-self-expansion properties per INSA v0.3 §8 (I-AUTH-*). Captured before any M-commit per INV-AUTH-1..5.

executor_identity.invocation_substrate: claude-code CLI, fresh session per INV-AUTH-5 (I-AUTH-05 freshness)
executor_identity.session_creation_mechanism: fresh session per M-commit boundary; no cross-session memory carryover
executor_identity.authentication_path: OAuth via Claude Code CLI; auth-token SHA recorded in inputs/authority-manifest.json under auth_token_sha (per protocol §6 preflight)

I_AUTH_01_capability_vs_permission_separ.separation_attestation: Capability set is enumerated and frozen pre-execution; permission grants are bound to capabilities 1:1 with no additional permissions. The executor cannot acquire permissions outside the preregistered set. Operator (Hermes) holds authority-grant capability but is not the executor.
